title: docs: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + examples
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates, agent/tool-calling examples, and quickstart docs for the developer docs site. This PR introduces opinionated RAG prompt templates, an agent example that demonstrates tool-calling (search, user-profile lookup, and calendar), and a set of quickstarts for getting started with RAG agents in hosted and private deployments. Motivation: reduce onboarding time for product engineers building RAG-enabled features and provide canonical examples that follow Redwood best-practices (prefix caching, safe tool-calling patterns, structured output). Changes include docs pages, a new examples/agents/tool-calling/ sample app, test fixtures for the docs site, and updated TOC entries. Checklist: 1) Add RAG templates and examples; 2) Add quickstarts for hosted and private setups; 3) Update docs site navigation and metadata; 4) Add unit tests for example harness; 5) Ensure CI/site-build passes. Related Linear items: ENG-4821, PM-210.
